notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The only records are a one-line listing in the Forest Lookouts history (no date, height or history) and a coordinate list (2021) that says it may include non-fire towers. The list gives no NGS benchmark ID for it, so there is no survey datasheet to check. Brief county and coordinates match the list. Story is shorter than the usual 120-word floor because nothing more was found; web search was unavailable (budget exhausted), and no other page in the cache or on direct reads named this tower. Next step for a later run with search: check U.S. Forest Service records for this Caldwell County tower and whether it still stands. Brief status and access stay unknown.
